Job Description – Executive / Senior Executive – AR (Accounts Receivable)

Department: Finance

Reports To: Manager - Finance

Location: Pune

About Spiro Spiro is building the operating system for electric mobility across Africa - spanning battery swapping infrastructure, fleet operations, energy commerce, and CRM - live across nine markets (Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Morocco, Benin, Togo, and Cameroon). Backed by $200+M in funding, we're working on top-notch, cutting-edge technology to solve problems at genuine IoT, fintech, and mobility scale - real-time data pipelines, connected hardware, and platforms that run physical infrastructure, not just dashboards. We build systems designed to scale to billions of events a day and over 1 million transactions a day, and engineered for 99.999% uptime.

We're looking for exceptional engineers and leaders to join us in Pune or Bangalore to help build this platform. This isn't a "big company problems, big company headcount" environment - you'll own systems end-to-end, with a bar for technical rigor set by experience at top product tech companies, but a working style built for a company still being built.

Role Overview

Manage centralized AR operations and strengthen collection governance across countries.

Key Responsibilities

•Manage customer invoicing and receivable accounting

•Monitor collections and overdue balances

•Perform cash application and customer reconciliations

•Support revenue accounting and reporting

•Monitor DSO and prepare collection MIS

•Support month-end closure and audit requirements

•Own the CRM process end-to-end

Requirements

•Experience: Minimum 5 years

•Strong understanding of accounting principles including debits and credits

•Hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA

•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

•Excellent communication and stakeholder management

•Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance)

•ERP Exposure

•SAP S/4HANA – Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Fiori

Our Footprint: Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Morocco, Benin, Togo, Cameroon.

Spiro is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all candidates based on merit, without regard to race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other protected status.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-term financial planning process.

Prepare monthly MIS reports, dashboards, and financial performance reviews.

Conduct variance analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve business performance.

Develop rolling forecasts and financial projections to support strategic planning.

Monitor business unit, product, project, and regional profitability.

Business Proposal Evaluation

Evaluate commercial viability of new business opportunities, projects, and strategic initiatives.

Prepare detailed financial models, ROI analysis, IRR, NPV, payback period, and sensitivity analysis for business proposals.

Review pricing models, investment proposals, and capital expenditure requests.

Support bid pricing, tenders, and large customer proposals from a financial perspective.

Partner with Sales and Business teams to optimize margins while maintaining competitiveness.

Present financial recommendations and business cases to senior management for approval.

Budgeting & Cost Management

Develop and monitor annual operating and capital budgets.

Track budget utilization and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

Drive initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability.

Support cost control measures across departments.

Business Analytics

Generate meaningful business insights using financial and operational data.

Develop KPI dashboards for business leaders.

Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.

Support management in strategic decision-making.

Commercial Finance

Review project profitability and monitor financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.

Analyze pricing strategies and customer profitability.

Support contract reviews and commercial negotiations from a finance perspective.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial outcomes.

Process Improvement

Strengthen financial planning processes and reporting frameworks.

Drive automation of MIS and financial reporting using ERP systems and advanced Excel/BI tools.

Improve forecasting accuracy and reporting efficiency.

Standardize financial planning and proposal evaluation templates.

Desired Candidate Profile
Education

CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) / Master's in Finance.

Certification in Financial Modeling or Business Analytics will be an added advantage.

Experience

Minimum 5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance, or Business Finance.

Experience in Telecom, System Integration, Manufacturing, Technology, Infrastructure, or Project-based businesses will be preferred.

Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, business case preparation, and proposal evaluation.

Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred), Advanced Excel, Power BI, or similar analytics tools. .

Company Description STM Fire Systems, based in Pune, is a premier provider of end-to-end fire protection and life safety solutions for commercial, industrial, educational, healthcare, and residential projects. The company is built on the pillars of innovation, integrity, and precise execution, specializing in the design, installation, and maintenance of advanced fire safety systems. STM Fire Systems delivers a comprehensive safety ecosystem, including fire detection and alarm systems, suppression systems, passive fire protection, life safety consulting, and ongoing maintenance services.

By integrating cutting-edge technology with rigorous engineering and compliance standards, the company ensures reliable protection well before emergencies occur. Clients partner with STM Fire Systems for strategic, infrastructure-integrated solutions that provide uncompromising safety and regulatory adherence.

Role Description The Senior Accountant role at STM Fire is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune.

The Senior

Accountant will manage day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and payroll support. This role will prepare and review financial statements, track project costs, monitor budgets, and ensure timely statutory and tax compliance.

The Senior

Accountant will collaborate with operations and project teams to align financial reporting with business activities and support management with financial analysis and forecasting. The position also involves implementing and improving internal controls, supporting audits, and ensuring accurate, compliant financial records. Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger accounting, financial statement preparation, reconciliations, and month-end closing.

Candidates should possess tax and compliance knowledge, including GST, TDS, statutory filings, and familiarity with relevant accounting standards and regulations. Candidates should possess financial analysis and budgeting skills, including variance analysis, cost tracking, project accounting, and forecasting. Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting and ERP software, MS Excel, and data management tools for efficient and accurate financial reporting.

Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams and external auditors. Relevant qualifications such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce; CA, CMA, CPA or equivalent) are an advantage. Prior experience in a senior accounting role, preferably in construction, engineering, or project-based industries, and familiarity with fire safety or infrastructure projects is beneficial.

Required Skills &

Qualifications Qualified Chartered Accountant certification. 13 years of relevant accounting, audit, taxation, or finance experience. Preferred Experience Areas Financial reporting Direct and indirect taxation Audit and assurance Typical Industries Public accounting firms Manufacturing IT and consulting Experience Level Senior Level .

Role & Responsibilities

1. Ownership of Books of Accounts

• Take complete ownership of the books of accounts for assigned Joint Ventures and Subsidiaries.

• Ensure all accounting transactions are recorded accurately, completely and within prescribed timelines.

• Maintain the General Ledger and Chart of Accounts.

• Ensure proper accounting and classification of income, expenditure, assets, liabilities and equity.

• Review accounting entries for correctness, accounting treatment and ledger mapping.

• Ensure compliance with applicable Accounting Standards, the Companies Act, 2013 and internal accounting policies.

• Identify, investigate and rectify accounting errors on a timely basis.

• Maintain complete and audit-ready books of accounts throughout the financial year.

2. Monthly, Quarterly & Annual Books Closure

• Own the end-to-end monthly, quarterly and annual books closure process.

• Prepare and execute detailed closure checklists for each reporting period.

• Ensure timely accounting of accruals, provisions, depreciation, amortization, prepaid expenses and all adjustment entries.

• Review all General Ledger accounts before closure to ensure completeness and accuracy.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to obtain pending accounting information within defined timelines.

• Ensure all accounting entries are supported by appropriate documentation prior to closure.

• Drive continuous improvement in books closure timelines and accuracy.

• Ensure assigned entities remain audit-ready throughout the year.

3. Financial Statement Preparation

• Prepare standalone financial statements in accordance with Division I of Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013.

• Prepare

• Balance Sheet

• Statement of Profit & Loss

• Cash Flow Statement

• Notes to Accounts

• Supporting schedules and disclosures

• Prepare detailed Balance Sheet schedules supporting every reported balance.

• Ensure compliance with applicable Accounting Standards and statutory disclosure requirements.

• Maintain detailed working papers supporting all financial statement disclosures.

4. Ledger Scrutiny & Reconciliations

• Perform comprehensive scrutiny of General Ledger accounts.

• Prepare and maintain Balance Sheet reconciliations on a monthly basis.

• Perform Bank Reconciliations.

• Perform Vendor Reconciliations.

• Perform Customer Reconciliations.

• Perform Inter-company Reconciliations.

• Prepare Fixed Asset Registers and reconciliations.

• Prepare GST, TDS and other statutory reconciliations.

• Investigate and resolve unreconciled balances and accounting discrepancies.

• Ensure every Balance Sheet account is fully substantiated with supporting documentation.

5. Documentation & Working Papers

• Maintain complete documentation supporting every accounting transaction.

• Ensure proper filing of invoices, agreements, approvals, journal vouchers and supporting schedules.

• Prepare standardized monthly working papers supporting books closure.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation throughout the financial year.

• Ensure proper version control and organization of accounting files.

• Develop and maintain accounting SOPs, checklists and process documentation.

• Strengthen documentation standards across the accounting function.

6. Audit & Statutory Compliance

• Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors and Tax Auditors.

• Prepare audit schedules and supporting documents.

• Resolve audit queries within agreed timelines.

• Ensure books and documentation are readily available for audits.

• Support preparation of statutory filings from an accounting perspective.

• Ensure compliance with statutory accounting requirements and internal financial controls.

7. Process Improvement & Internal Controls

• Continuously improve accounting processes and month-end closure procedures.

• Recommend automation and standardization opportunities.

• Strengthen accounting controls and documentation practices.

• Ensure adherence to internal accounting policies and SOPs.

• Identify process gaps and implement corrective actions.

• Contribute towards improving the efficiency and quality of the accounting function.

Essential

• CA Intermediate (Both Groups) cleared.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
